title: Pullback of a sheaf of modules along a morphism of schemes
statement:
Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with underlying continuous map $g$ and ring-sheaf map $g^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to g_*\mathcal O_X$, equivalently $g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (on the Zariski site of $Y$), the *pullback* $g^*\mathcal G$ is the sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules

$$
g^*\mathcal G=\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}g^{-1}\mathcal G,
$$

using the sheaf tensor product and change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], where $g^{-1}\mathcal G$ is the inverse image sheaf of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (sheafification of $V\mapsto\varinjlim_{U\supseteq g(V)}\mathcal G(U)$) with its $g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$-module structure. This is a functor $g^*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$, left adjoint to the pushforward $g_*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$, with $\mathrm{id}^*\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $(h\circ g)^*\cong g^*h^*$.

proof.text: For a module morphism u, use the canonical linear inverse-image map of [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module], then sectionwise extension of scalars and module sheafification of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Naturality is exactly SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom_naturality applied to inverseImageModuleMap. To prove tensorPullbackMap_id and tensorPullbackMap_comp, compare the presheaf morphisms sectionwise by PresheafOfModules.hom_ext. Unfold inverseImageModuleMap and homMk: the identity and composition laws of the abelian inverse-image functor and SheafOfModules.toSheaf give the corresponding section-map equalities. Functor.map_id and Functor.map_comp for extension of scalars and sheafification finish the two laws. This defines the displayed tensor formula as a functor on the module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The pushforward is the sectionwise one in Stacks 0095, with its action restricted along the structure-sheaf map; its tensor-formula adjunction is proved in the second step below.

source.place: Tag 0095, definition-pushforward, lines 3116-3152 (pullback and pushforward functors)

proof.text: Apply the existing proved normalized adjunction theorem [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], whose sectionwise unit is the module-sheafification unit applied to 1 tensor the abelian inverse-image unit. This is definitionally tensorPullbackSection, so it supplies existence with the required normalization. For any other normalized adjunction, SheafOfModules.hom_ext, PresheafOfModules.hom_ext and sectionwise extensionality identify its unit with the supplied unit. Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.ext then proves equality of the adjunctions.

Construct tensorPullbackSectionId and tensorPullbackSectionComp directly from the uniquely section-normalized adjunctions just proved. For identity, transport along Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId and apply Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq against Adjunction.id. For composition, compose the normalized adjunctions, transport their right adjoint along Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp, and apply leftAdjointUniq against the normalized adjunction for the composite. No existence-only comparison theorem is needed.

lean.note: Section 1(B) interface repair. The upstream explicit tensorPullback functor is retained by public import, with no duplicate pullback definition. Its recorded adjunction/composition interface supplies only Nonempty witnesses; choosing those freely does not fix the scalar normalization required for canonical determinant base change. This module states the uniquely normalized adjunction whose unit sends m to the actual section 1 tensor m, and constructs its identity and composition comparisons by left-adjoint uniqueness. The named existence-and-uniqueness theorem postpones only this universal-property proof, which determines the chosen adjunction uniquely.
